Name: Tales From The Bayou
Author: mythgarr
Description:
Tales From the Bayou expands Stardew Valley, adding content inspired by the bayous of the American south. Development is only beginning, watch for more in the future!

[b][u][size=3]Features[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Bug Zapper - Tired of running out of Bug Meat? Bug Zappers give you between 1-5 bug meat each day!
[*]An all-new Swamp containing 2 new variety of fish!
[/list]
[u]Roadmap[/u]
[list]
[*][size=2]A large swamp area inhabited by gators, snakes and teeming with fish![/size]
[*][size=2]Custom fishing minigame - reel in a snake or gator, then use your weapon to finish them off![/size]
[*][size=2]Crops, including Okra, Celery, Bell Peppers and more![/size]
[*][size=2]A boat that allows you to reach inaccessible parts of the swamp![/size]
[/list]
[size=4][u][b]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded!
[/b][/u][/size]
